content: Spear.subscribe/4 signature: (connection, subscriber_pid_or_name, stream_name :: String.t() | :all, opts :: Keyword.t()) -> {:ok, reference()} | {:error, any()}. For :all stream, from: accepts :start, :end, a non-negative integer position, a Spear.Event.t(), or a Spear.Filter.Checkpoint.t(). Integer positions for subscriptions are exclusive (from: 0 returns event 1 first). Subscriber receives Spear.Event.t() or Spear.Filter.Checkpoint.t() messages, plus {:eos, subscription_ref, :closed | :dropped} on termination. Spear.Event.metadata contains commit_position (integer, e.g. 18446744073709551615) and prepare_position integers. Spear.Event.to_checkpoint/1 converts event to Spear.Filter.Checkpoint.t() useful for storing :all stream positions. EventStoreDB 23.10+ also sends {:caught_up, ref} and {:fell_behind, ref} messages.
